description: This PHP source file defines the abstract class OX_Component, a helper class for managing plugins and components in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for loading, instantiating, and interacting with plugin components, including dynamic inclusion of class files, component retrieval, and static method calls.

classes.name: OX_Component
classes.description: An abstract helper class for managing plugin components, including loading, instantiation, method invocation, and hook registration within the Revive Adserver system.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a plugin component class based on extension, group, and optional component name.

methods.name: factoryByComponentIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a component instance from a colon-separated component identifier string.

methods.name: _isGroupInstalled
methods.description: Checks if a plugin group is installed based on configuration.

methods.name: _isGroupEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a plugin group is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: _includeComponentFile
methods.description: Includes the PHP class file for a component based on extension, group, and optional component name.

methods.name: _getComponentClassName
methods.description: Generates the expected class name for a component based on extension, group, and component name.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves an array of component objects from a specified extension and optional group, with optional recursion and filtering by enabled status.

methods.name: _getComponentsFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of component files in a plugin extension or extension/group, optionally recursive.

methods.name: _getComponentGroupsFromDirectory
methods.description: Returns subdirectory names (groups) within a given directory.

methods.name: _getComponentFilesFromDirectory
methods.description: Recursively finds component files matching the suffix in a directory and its subdirectories.

methods.name: callStaticMethod
methods.description: Calls a static method on a component class after including its file.

methods.name: callOnComponents
methods.description: Runs a specified method on an array of component objects.

methods.name: getListOfRegisteredComponentsForHook
methods.description: Returns components registered for a specific hook.

methods.name: getComponentsHookCache
methods.description: Retrieves or loads the cache of component hooks.

methods.name: getComponentIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a colon-separated string identifying the component.

methods.name: parseComponentIdentifier
methods.description: Parses a component identifier string into its parts.

methods.name: getFallbackHandler
methods.description: Loads and returns a fallback handler object for a given extension.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a string using the component's translation object.

methods.name: onEnable
methods.description: Hook method called when the component is enabled.

methods.name: onDisable
methods.description: Hook method called when the component is disabled.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the component's identifier string.
